Sikkim Manipal University was born to with the basic objective of strengthening the close link of education to skill development and the making the youth of Sikkim educated, skilled and employable, giving them the capacity to harness diverse opportunities both within and outside Sikkim. This will also create more job opportunities for our youth, thus solving the growing unemployment in the State. All the hostel's services provided have the best state of the art facilities to make students comfortable far from their homes. All the hostels are under the supervision of their respective Chief wardens.
